description: React component for a modal overlay displaying cost details and raw JSON data, including user info, project breakdown, and copy-to-clipboard functionality.

classes.name: ViewCostDetailsModal
classes.description: React functional component rendering a modal with cost details and JSON view.

methods.name: loadName
methods.description: Fetches user name from API if not provided, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Converts various input formats to a numeric value, handling strings with currency symbols.

methods.name: fallbackCopy
methods.description: Copies text to clipboard using a fallback method if navigator.clipboard is unavailable.

methods.name: handleCopy
methods.description: Handles copying JSON data to clipboard and updates copy status.
